svg.title: Mockup 13: Shell themes
svg.text: 13 · Shell themes: Dark, Light and high contrast, chosen by each person (organiser)
Use case: an organiser plans in a bright office by day and runs the hall by night. L6, L7; the event's admin tokens still apply on top, with the contrast fallback.

svg.text: Only tokens change; every component of packages/ui draws
from them, so a page needs no theme code of its own.
Each palette passes WCAG AA for text and AAA in high
contrast; CI's a11y run shoots one page per theme.
